metadata.name: Midnight Magnolia AI Evaluation Dataset
metadata.description: Test queries for evaluating AI-generated content across journal, affirmation, and document generation features

queries.query: Generate a 90-day sobriety journal entry for day 15. Theme: finding peace in stillness. Include a morning reflection prompt and evening gratitude section.
Create a day 45 sobriety journal page focused on rebuilding trust with yourself. Include affirmations and a 'small wins' tracker.
Design an ADHD-friendly daily planner page with time blocks, dopamine menu suggestions, and a 'brain dump' section. Keep it gentle and non-judgmental.
Write a healing journal prompt about reconnecting with your inner child through Southern memories. Include sensory details like magnolia blooms and summer evenings.
Create a 'Magnolia Messages' affirmation card about ancestral strength and resilience. Use Southern Gothic imagery and healing-centered language.
Generate a 'Softest Wins' affirmation about choosing rest as a radical act of self-love. Make it trauma-informed and gentle.
Write an affirmation card for a Black woman entrepreneur about turning creative brilliance into sustainable income without burnout.
Create a healing-centered resume summary for a creative entrepreneur transitioning from corporate work to digital product creation. Highlight transferable skills warmly.
Write a grant application letter for a small business focused on healing arts and digital wellness tools for underserved communities.
Generate a professional bio for a digital healer and artist who creates Southern Gothic journals and tarot content. Keep it warm but professional.
Write a Southern Gothic interpretation of The High Priestess card, connecting it to ancestral wisdom and intuition. Include imagery of magnolias and moonlight.
Create a daily tarot reading introduction for someone seeking guidance on their creative business. Use the Midnight Magnolia voice - warm, mystical, and empowering.
Generate a Southern Gothic creative writing prompt about a woman discovering her grandmother's hidden journals in an old magnolia-shaded house.
Create an AI art prompt for a digital illustration featuring: crescent moon, magnolia blooms, antique gold frame, and Adinkra symbols. Southern Gothic aesthetic.
Write a genealogy reflection prompt that helps someone explore their family history through the lens of healing and ancestral wisdom.
